subject: Renewal: security assurance retainer (attack simulations & app audits)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: security assurance retainer (attack simulations & app audits)

Team —

RedShield came back with their standard retainer proposal for our annual program; I attached their first draft SOW they sent (RedShield_Retainer_SOW_2027_v1.pdf). High level: 12-month retainer, 2 full red-team engagements, 3 appsec assessments, SLA for evidence delivery and post-engagement reports.

Asks:
- Neha: please flag any non-starters in the SOW on security/data handling (log access, retention, re-use of test artifacts).
- Marissa: can you evaluate the commercial ask vs. last year and suggest target pricing bands (retainer vs per-engagement)?
- Hannah / Legal: we may need indemnity/data-handling language — I can loop in Vivek and Finance after initial feedback.

Goal: decide if we want to proceed on a 12-month retainer or keep per-engagement POs. We have Q3 budget for this but want to lock pricing by end of May if possible.

Tessa
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: RedShield_Retainer_SOW_2027_v1.pdf
From: Jordan Sanders <j.sanders@redshieldsec.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: security assurance retainer (attack simulations & app audits)

Hi Tessa — great to reconnect. Thanks for sharing the details. I attached our formal Statement of Work and a pricing summary (RedShield_Statement_of_Work_2027.pdf). Summary below: 

- 12-month retainer: $165k (covers 2 red-team engagements + 3 appsec assessments + 20 hours of advisory support)
- Per-engagement alternative: red team $95k each, appsec $18k each
- Standard deliverables: executive report, technical report, remediation tracker, raw log package (30-day retention)
- Timeline: first engagement within 6 weeks of PO, second engagement between months 5–9

We can add a PO-friendly invoice and short-form SOW if Legal prefers. We are open to limited SLAs on report turnaround (drafts in 7 business days, final within 15).

If you want, I can prepare a 12-month retainer discount (5–10%) if you commit by end of May.

Jordan Sanders
Engagement Lead | RedShield Security
j.sanders@redshieldsec.com | +1 415-555-0191
Attachment: RedShield_Statement_of_Work_2027.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: security assurance retainer (attack simulations & app audits)

Thanks — skimmed the SOW. A few callouts we need RedShield to address before we move forward:

1) Data handling/logs: 30-day raw log retention is fine for deliverables, but we need a clause that prohibits reuse of customer artifacts for training or third-party sharing. Add explicit non-derivative clause.
2) Evidence custody: require hashed manifests for any raw artifacts and an option to have logs transferred to our S3 with our KMS. We should not hand over keys.
3) Scope creep: define explicit per-engagement change order rates and a not-to-exceed hours cap for advisory.
4) Insurance / liability: minimum 1M cyber E&O; limit of liability should be negotiable.

Hannah — please advise on any standard language you want Vivek to include (indemnity, data retention, redaction timelines).

If RedShield can accept the non-training / non-retention language and provide SOC2 attestations for their control environment, I think we can move to a PO.

Neha
Head of Information Security Programs

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: security assurance retainer (attack simulations & app audits)

Looping legal and finance. Quick commercial proposal from our side before I talk to RedShield: 

Option A — 12-month retainer (preferred): $150k (RedShield offered $165k). Requirements: 2 red-team windows, 3 appsec assessments, 20 advisory hours, 30-day raw data handover optional to our S3, SOC2 attestation on vendor controls. Include 10% performance holdback until remediation validation.

Option B — pay-per-engagement: keep current per-engagement pricing but require a 30% deposit up front for scheduling and a fixed change-order hourly rate.

Legal asks (Vivek): add explicit non-training clause, confirm indemnity and data-handling, and add a simple SLA credit for missed report windows. Finance (Aditya): confirm budget cadence — Q3 Ops budget can absorb Option A if we hit the lower target ($150k).

Quoted from vendor below for context: 
> "We can add a PO-friendly invoice and short-form SOW if Legal prefers... we are open to a 5–10% discount if you commit by end of May."

I can take the lead on commercial negotiation with Jordan if Vivek gives the green light on redlines.

Marissa
Vendor Ops & Procurement

From: Jordan Sanders <j.sanders@redshieldsec.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@redshieldsec.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 17:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: security assurance retainer (attack simulations & app audits)

Marissa / Tessa — thanks for the clear feedback and for looping Legal/Finance. We reviewed your requested changes with our contracts team and can accommodate the following: 

- Add explicit non-training/non-use clause: vendor will not reuse customer artifacts for ML training or share with third parties.
- Provide SOC2 Type II report for our control environment upon execution (redacted as needed).
- Offer a 10% discount on the 12-month retainer when Redwood signs the retainer SOW by 31-May-2027 (revised retainer $148,500).
- Update raw log handling: option to push logs to your S3 with vendor-written manifest; keys remain with Redwood.
- Liability/insurance: can confirm cyber E&O of $1M and willing to discuss cap language in the master agreement.

Attached: updated SOW and an invoice stub for the retainer term (RedShield_Statement_of_Work_2027.pdf, RedShield_Invoice_9876.pdf). Please confirm if Finance wants a formal PO or if we should execute the short-form SOW + Invoice.

Jordan Sanders
Engagement Lead | RedShield Security
Attachment: RedShield_Statement_of_Work_2027.pdf; RedShield_Invoice_9876.pdf
